evidence.passage: FoodShare members complete a six-month report form to keep their benefits. The report confirms household details for the review period.
When the agency requests proof, the member sends the listed documents through an official channel by the stated date. The agency, not this service, decides whether the proof is enough.

The FoodShare work requirement has work routes, exemptions and good-cause follow-up. Whether it applies depends on the member's own situation. Age alone does not decide it, and official staff decide any exemption.
